summary: Frontend-only test (mobile 430x900, admin PRO) of the 3 new Maestro tools: Marketplace (Step 1), Timer (Step 3), Meteo (Step 4). Login via header 'Accedi' -> admin@mikilab.de worked, PaywallGate bypassed (maestro-stepper visible). Marketplace: publish/list/filter/contact-link/remove/localStorage persistence all PASS. Timer: presets, custom timer, start/pause/resume/reset/remove, localStorage persistence all PASS. Meteo: Stuttgart search hit Open-Meteo successfully (17 C / 67% / 14 km/h, 'Stoccarda, Germania'), water 34.4 C and proof 214 min shown; changing meteo-target (26) -> 40.4 C and meteo-basemin (240) -> 429 min updated correctly. Step navigation maestro-next/prev across 5 steps OK. FAB overlap check: pb-40 keeps CTAs clickable, hit-test on bottom-most timer-toggle returned the button itself (no interception). Only console errors are the expected pre-login 401s. One functional gap found: timers freeze when the Timer tool is unmounted / page reloaded (not wall-clock based), so alarms cannot fire in background.

ui_bugs.issue: Countdown is interval-driven only while the component is mounted. Navigating away (Home tab / back to tool grid) for ~9s reduced the timer by just 1s; after a full page reload the timer resumed from the stored value with state 'running' (Pausa label) instead of subtracting real elapsed time. Consequence: the alarm overlay/sound can never fire unless the Timer screen stays open, which defeats the purpose of a bakery timer.
Price rendered as '€ 2500' instead of grouped 'it-IT' format ('2.500') in the test browser. Cosmetic/locale-data dependent, low impact.

issues: Radio/Parla FABs visually overlap the lower area but pb-40 spacing prevents actual click interception - verified clickable, no fix needed
A faint watermark image sits behind the FAB strip above the bottom nav; check it is intentional

action_items: Make Timer wall-clock based: store endsAt timestamp in localStorage and compute remaining = endsAt - Date.now(); on mount/visibilitychange recompute and fire alarm if elapsed. Optionally keep the ticking loop mounted at app level (or use a Notification/Service Worker) so alarms fire while the user is on other tools.

Optional: setRinging() is called inside the setTimers updater (impure state updater); move alarm detection to a useEffect on timers to avoid double-fire under StrictMode/concurrent rendering, and support several timers firing at once (currently only the last fired is kept).
Optional: format Marketplace price consistently (Intl.NumberFormat with explicit locale).
critical_code_review_comments: Timer.jsx: remaining/running persisted without timestamp -> loses real time on unmount/reload; alarm unreachable in background.
Timer.jsx line ~57: side effect (setRinging) inside a state updater function.
Meteo.jsx: no timeout/abort on the external Open-Meteo fetches; a hanging network would leave the button disabled with the spinner forever (add AbortController + timeout).

Marketplace.jsx: images are stored as base64 in localStorage; several listings with photos can exceed the ~5MB quota and the QuotaExceededError from the persistence useEffect is unhandled (wrap in try/catch and surface a message).
seed_data_creation: Transient localStorage entries only (mikilab_market listing 'TEST Impastatrice 40kg' and test timers) - all removed at the end of each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: pre-set localStorage 'mikilab_onboarding' {done:true} to skip onboarding, then click intro-close-btn if present, then login-btn -> auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit, then nav-tab-maestro. Steps clickable via maestro-step-1..5; tools: market (step1), timer (step3), meteo (step4); maestro-back-btn returns to the tool grid. Open-Meteo geocoding + forecast are reachable from this test network (Stuttgart resolved). Pre-login 401 console errors are expected. Timer background/wall-clock gap is the only open functional issue.
rca_of_the_issue: Timer.jsx decrements 'remaining' inside a setInterval that lives in the Timer component; when the tool is unmounted the interval is cleared and no elapsed-time reconciliation happens on remount because only remaining/running (not an absolute end timestamp) are persisted to localStorage.
